title: onehotencode
summary: Encode class labels as one-hot vectors.

gpu_support.notes: GPU inputs are gathered to host. Class discovery and label matching run on CPU.

description: `onehotencode(A,featureDim)` expands labels in `A` into one-hot vectors along `featureDim`.
behaviors: `featureDim` must identify a singleton dimension in `A`; dimensions beyond `ndims(A)` are padded with singleton dimensions.
Categorical inputs infer classes from the full category order, including categories not observed in the input values.
Noncategorical inputs require `ClassNames`; class names must be unique and match the input label type.
`OutputType` supports `double`, `single`, and `logical`; `single` is represented with RunMat's numeric tensor storage.
Missing labels and labels not listed in `ClassNames` encode as all-`NaN` feature vectors for numeric output.
Logical output cannot represent missing labels or labels excluded by `ClassNames` and raises an error in those cases.

faqs.question: Can I control the class order?
faqs.answer: Yes. Supply the `ClassNames` name-value option for noncategorical inputs, or use the category order of a categorical input.
